answer.justification: Layer-1 relative L2 is 0.088, inside the fine-tuned range (0.086-0.092) and below the quantized (0.096-0.105) and system-prompted (0.113-0.133) ranges. The mid-layer size ratio is 1.016, so the internal state grows; this matches fine-tuned (1.017-1.023), whereas quantized and system-prompted both shrink it (below 1). The layer-2 spike is 0.2, far below the system-prompted range (31.7-64), and the onset layer is 3, within the fine-tuned range (3-14) and unlike the system-prompted range (7-8). Direction consistency is 0.627, in the fine-tuned range (0.618-0.705) and not the quantized 0.513. Effective rank of 3.63 and cosine of 0.957 sit slightly outside the fine-tuned ranges (3.58 and 0.955) but are still closer to fine-tuned than to quantized. The layer-16 value of 0.155 is also slightly low, and the final-layer value of 0.283 is just under the fine-tuned range (0.288-0.417). Base is ruled out because the differences are non-zero.
